items.source: baseUrl - the base URL for the API (null to use default or environment variable)
items.translation: baseUrl - API 的基础 URL（为 null 时使用默认值或环境变量）

items.source: apiKey - the API key (null to detect from environment)
items.translation: apiKey - API 密钥（设为 null 则从环境变量中获取）

items.source: timeout - the request timeout (null to use default of 60 seconds)
items.translation: timeout - 请求超时时间（设为 null 则使用默认的 60 秒）

items.source: maxRetries - the maximum number of retries (null to use default of 2)
items.translation: maxRetries - 最大重试次数（为 null 时使用默认值 2）

items.source: proxy - the proxy to use (null for no proxy)
items.translation: proxy - 要使用的代理（无代理时为 null）

items.source: customHeaders - additional HTTP headers to include in requests
items.translation: customHeaders - 请求中需包含的额外 HTTP 标头

items.translation: 已配置的 Anthropic 客户端

items.translation: 已配置的异步 Anthropic 客户端

items.source: Creates a synchronous Anthropic client whose underlying OkHttp client is instrumented with Micrometer: each HTTP attempt emits an observation (span + metric + traceparent propagation), and, when a MeterRegistry is supplied, OkHttp connection-pool gauges are bound to it.
items.translation: 创建一个同步的 Anthropic 客户端，其底层的 OkHttp 客户端已使用 Micrometer 进行增强：每次 HTTP 请求都会发出观察结果（包含 span、metric 以及 `traceparent` 传播），并且当提供 `MeterRegistry` 时，OkHttp 连接池的仪表会被绑定到该注册表上。

items.source: observationRegistry - the registry the OkHttp observation interceptor reports to; pass ObservationRegistry.NOOP to disable
items.translation: observationRegistry - OkHttp 观察拦截器向其报告的注册表；传递 ObservationRegistry.NOOP 以禁用该功能。

items.source: dispatcherExecutor - the OkHttp dispatcher executor; null to use the library-managed default
items.translation: dispatcherExecutor - OkHttp 的调度器执行器；若为 null，则使用库管理的默认值。

items.source: httpClientCustomizers - customizers applied to the underlying OkHttp client builder after Spring AI's own defaults; useful for registering interceptors (e.g. OAuth2 bearer-token injection) or custom TLS configuration
items.translation: `httpClientCustomizers` - 在应用 Spring AI 自身默认配置后，应用于底层 OkHttp 客户端构建器的自定义器；可用于注册拦截器（例如 OAuth2 访问令牌注入）或自定义 TLS 配置。

items.source: This utility class provides static factory methods for creating both synchronous (AnthropicClient) and asynchronous (AnthropicClientAsync) clients with comprehensive configuration support. It handles API key detection from environment variables and provides sensible defaults for timeouts and retry behavior.
items.translation: 此工具类提供了用于创建同步（AnthropicClient）和异步（AnthropicClientAsync）客户端的静态工厂方法，并支持全面的配置。它可从环境变量中检测 API 密钥，并为超时和重试行为提供合理的默认值。

items.source: Creates a synchronous Anthropic client with the specified configuration. Delegates to setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry) with a no-op observation registry and no meter registry — i.e. HTTP-layer observability is disabled.
items.translation: 创建一个具有指定配置的同步 Anthropic 客户端。该操作会委托给 setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry) 方法，但使用一个无操作的观察注册表且没有度量注册表——即禁用 HTTP 层可观测性。

items.source: Creates a synchronous Anthropic client backed by a caller-supplied dispatcher executor (e.g. one built around Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor() on Java 21+). The caller owns the executor's lifecycle; closing the resulting client will not shut it down. See setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry) for the remaining parameter semantics.
items.translation: 创建一个由调用者提供的调度器执行器支持的同步 Anthropic 客户端（例如，在 Java 21+ 上围绕 Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor() 构建的执行器）。调用者负责执行器的生命周期；关闭由此生成的客户端不会将其关闭。有关其余参数的语义，请参阅 setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry)。

items.source: Creates an asynchronous Anthropic client with the specified configuration. Delegates to setupAsyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry) with a no-op observation registry and no meter registry — i.e. HTTP-layer observability is disabled.
items.translation: 创建具有指定配置的异步 Anthropic 客户端。 委托给 setupAsyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry) ，使用无操作的观察注册表且没有度量注册表——即禁用 HTTP 层可观测性。

items.source: Creates a synchronous Anthropic client backed by a caller-supplied dispatcher executor and with optional HTTP client customizers. See setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry, ExecutorService) for the remaining parameter semantics.
items.translation: 创建一个由调用者提供的调度器执行器支持的同步 Anthropic 客户端，并可选地配置 HTTP 客户端自定义器。有关其余参数的语义，请参阅 setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry, ExecutorService)。

items.source: Creates an asynchronous Anthropic client whose underlying OkHttp client is instrumented with Micrometer. See setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry) for parameter semantics.
items.translation: 创建一个异步 Anthropic 客户端，其底层的 OkHttp 客户端已使用 Micrometer 进行增强。有关参数语义，请参阅 setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry)。

items.source: Creates an asynchronous Anthropic client backed by a caller-supplied dispatcher executor. The caller owns the executor's lifecycle; closing the resulting client will not shut it down. See setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry, ExecutorService) for the dispatcher executor's role.
items.translation: 创建一个由调用者提供的调度器执行器支持的异步 Anthropic 客户端。调用者负责管理执行器的生命周期；关闭由此创建的客户端不会将其关闭。有关调度器执行器的作用，请参阅 setupSyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry, ExecutorService)。

items.source: Creates an asynchronous Anthropic client backed by a caller-supplied dispatcher executor and with optional HTTP client customizers. items.translation: 创建一个由调用者提供的调度器执行器支持的异步 Anthropic 客户端，并可选地配置 HTTP 客户端自定义器。有关其余参数的语义，请参阅 setupAsyncClient(String, String, Duration, Integer, Proxy, Map, ObservationRegistry, MeterRegistry, ExecutorService)。
